content: To study the correlation as we vary the number of divergent references, we also collected binary labels from workers for whether a reference is entailed by the corresponding table. We define a reference as entailed when it mentions only information which can be inferred from the table. Each table and reference pair was judged by 3 independent workers, and we used the majority vote as the label for that pair. Overall, only INLINEFORM0 of the references were labeled as entailed by the table. Fleiss' INLINEFORM1 was INLINEFORM2 , which indicates a fair agreement. We found the workers sometimes disagreed on what information can be reasonably entailed by the table.
